d:
Kendriy sansdiy mantri kiren rijiju ne sansad ka vishesh satr bulane ka elan kiya hai. unhonne eks par jari bayan men vishesh satr ka maqsad 'zaruri sarkari kamkaj niptana' bataya hai. lekin vipakshi netaon ne dava kiya hai ki is vishesh satr men dilimiteshan bil laya jaega. isi sal aprail men hue matdan men do tihaee bahumat na hone se yah bil pas nahin ho paya tha. aise men saval uth rahe hain ki kya sanvidhan sanshodhan bil pas karane ke lie bijepi ke aguvaee vale sattarurh gathbandhan endie ne is bar do tihaee se jyada vot juta lie hain? kya kahte hain ganit?
Aavaz- mukund jha
